title: Tunisian Chicken Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African stew made with chicken, couscous, and spices. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add Tunisian spice blend, olives, and lemon juice. Stir to combine.
Add enough water to cover the chicken and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in couscous and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes or until it is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional olives and lemon wedges if desired.
